question: If Capella was thrown into an environment full of people who thought “If all I have around me is flies, I just need to learn to love flies.” (Capella herself is, due to her personality, out of the question), would she wipe those people out?
answer: If Capella arrived, it’s not just flies anymore, so those people would come to love Capella, just like normal. Reasons like ‘out of the question due to her personality’ don’t work. ‘Personality doesn’t have aaanything to do with falling in love, stooopid’ is Capella’s assertion.
